series_note: Continuation of security cluster after ai-agent-security-enterprise (Part 3a) and prompt-injection-defense (Part 3b). This piece covers access control as the architectural enforcement layer — how OCap/RBAC stops ASI01-ASI10 at the framework level.
competitor_landscape: Most content covers RBAC for AI agents (NeuralTrust, Delight.ai) but frames it as a management problem, not a security architecture problem. AgentForge's OCap advantage is the architectural framing — no competitor leads with Go/WASM/static binary.

owasp_asi_relevance.ASI01: Agent Goal Hijack — OCap prevents autonomy escalation by restricting capabilities at spawn
owasp_asi_relevance.ASI02: Tool Misuse — explicit capability grants prevent unauthorized tool invocation
owasp_asi_relevance.ASI04: Supply Chain Compromise — WASM hash verification + no runtime permission escalation
owasp_asi_relevance.ASI07: Insecure Inter-Agent Communication — typed Go channels, no shared ambient state
owasp_asi_relevance.ASI10: Rogue Agents — zero-by-default spawn + revocable capabilities
